import base64
M=op('/project1/mediaSwitcher')

# --- 1. drive CHOPs ---
if M.op('fx_drive_speed') is None:
    M.create(speedCHOP,'fx_drive_speed')
sp=M.op('fx_drive_speed')
sp.par.speed.val=1.0
try: sp.par.combinetype.val='sum'
except Exception: pass

if M.op('fx_pulsos_speed') is None:
    M.create(speedCHOP,'fx_pulsos_speed')
ps=M.op('fx_pulsos_speed')
ps.par.speed.expr="op('/project1/audio_jev/beat_out_null')['bpm'] / 60.0"

if M.op('fx_pulsos_offset') is None:
    M.create(constantCHOP,'fx_pulsos_offset')
off=M.op('fx_pulsos_offset')
off.par.value0.val=0.0

if M.op('fx_pulsos') is None:
    M.create(mathCHOP,'fx_pulsos')
mp=M.op('fx_pulsos')
try:
    mp.inputConnectors[0].connect(ps)
    mp.inputConnectors[1].connect(off)
    mp.par.multfunc.val='add'
    mp.par.channelnamematch.val='*'
except Exception as e:
    print('mathCHOP wire err', repr(e))

# --- 2. expressions on all fx scene uniforms ---
EXPR = {
 'uFxTime':   "op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/fx_drive_speed')['chan1']",
 'uPulsosS':  "op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/fx_pulsos')['chan1']",
 'uBass':     "op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/ar_null')['bass']",
 'uMid':      "op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/ar_null')['mid']",
 'uHigh':     "op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/ar_null')['high']",
 'uBpm':      "op('/project1/audio_jev/beat_out_null')['bpm']",
 'uBeat':     "op('/project1/audio_jev/beat_out_null')['beatcount']",
 'uBeatPhase':"op('/project1/audio_jev/beat_out_null')['beatpos']",
}
n=0
for s in M.op('scenes').children:
    ctx = s.fetch('fx_ctx', None)
    if not ctx:
        continue
    g = s.op('fx')
    if g is None:
        continue
    for nm, i in ctx.items():
        try:
            p = g.par['vec%dvaluex' % i]
            if p is not None:
                p.expr = EXPR[nm]
                n += 1
        except Exception:
            pass
print('expression-bound uniforms:', n)

# --- 3. fx_clock v3 + fx_exec ---
c=M.op('fx_clock')
c.text=base64.b64decode('').decode()
compile(c.text,'c','exec')
e=M.op('fx_exec')
EXEC=("def onFrameStart(dat):"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"try:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/fx_clock').module.fx_sync()"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"except Exception:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"pass"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"try:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"op('/project1/mediaSwitcher/fx_clock').module.fx_thumbs()"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"except Exception:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"pass"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"try:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"op('/project1/services/services_svc').module.svc_watch()"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"except Exception:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"pass"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"try:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"op('/project1/audio_jev/beat_cmd').module.watch()"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"except Exception:"+chr(10)+chr(9)*2+"pass"+chr(10)+
 chr(9)+"return"+chr(10))
e.text=EXEC
compile(e.text,'e','exec')
print('fx_clock v3 + fx_exec installed')
